description: This file contains unit tests for JSON serialization of Orleans framework types, focusing on GrainId and collections involving GrainId, using the Xunit testing framework.

classes.name: JsonSerializerTests
classes.description: A test class that verifies the JSON serialization and deserialization of various Orleans GrainId types and collections.

methods.name: Serialization_GrainId_RoundTrip
methods.description: Tests serialization and deserialization of a GrainId object.

methods.name: Serialization_WithGrainIdType_RoundTrip
methods.description: Tests serialization and deserialization of a wrapper type containing a GrainId.

methods.name: Serialization_WithGrainIdMapType_RoundTrip
methods.description: Tests serialization and deserialization of a wrapper type containing a dictionary of GrainId to int.

methods.name: Serialization_WithGrainIdConcurrentDictionaryType_RoundTrip
methods.description: Tests serialization and deserialization of a wrapper type containing a ConcurrentDictionary of GrainId to int.

methods.name: Serialization_WithGrainIdHashSetType_RoundTrip
methods.description: Tests serialization and deserialization of a wrapper type containing a HashSet of GrainId.
